panels.description: Aggregates use the dashboard time range. Month boundaries follow PostgreSQL `date_trunc` in the database session timezone. **Calories (kcal)** sums `activities.calories` (from Strava detailed activity when synced); activities without that field contribute 0 to the period total.
panels.title: By calendar month

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('month', start_date)::date AS "Month",
  COUNT(*)::int AS "Activities",
  ROUND((SUM(distance) / 1000.0)::numeric, 1) AS "Distance (km)",
  SUM(moving_time)::bigint AS "Moving time (s)",
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(trimp, 0))::numeric, 0) AS "TRIMP",
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(total_elevation_gain, 0))::numeric, 0) AS "Elevation (m)",
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(calories, 0))::numeric, 0) AS "Calories (kcal)"
FROM activities
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_date)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC

panels.description: Sums `activities.calories` per calendar year (Strava kcal when present on the row).
panels.title: By calendar year

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('year', start_date)::date AS "Year",
  COUNT(*)::int AS "Activities",
  ROUND((SUM(distance) / 1000.0)::numeric, 1) AS "Distance (km)",
  SUM(moving_time)::bigint AS "Moving time (s)",
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(trimp, 0))::numeric, 0) AS "TRIMP",
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(total_elevation_gain, 0))::numeric, 0) AS "Elevation (m)",
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(calories, 0))::numeric, 0) AS "Calories (kcal)"
FROM activities
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_date)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC

panels.description: Rolling 28 days ending now vs the 28 days immediately before.
panels.title: TRIMP last 28 days

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(trimp), 0)::numeric, 0) AS "TRIMP" FROM activities WHERE start_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '28 days' AND start_date < NOW()

panels.description: The 28-day window before the current last-28-days window.
panels.title: TRIMP prior 28 days

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(trimp), 0)::numeric, 0) AS "TRIMP" FROM activities WHERE start_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '56 days' AND start_date < NOW() - INTERVAL '28 days'
SELECT ROUND((SUM(distance) / 1000.0)::numeric, 1) AS "km" FROM activities WHERE start_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '28 days' AND start_date < NOW()

panels.description: Calendar month to date vs the same calendar month one year ago (full month total).
panels.title: TRIMP this calendar month (MTD)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(trimp), 0)::numeric, 0) AS "TRIMP" FROM activities WHERE start_date >= date_trunc('month', NOW()) AND start_date < NOW()

panels.title: TRIMP same month last year (full month)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(trimp), 0)::numeric, 0) AS "TRIMP" FROM activities WHERE start_date >= date_trunc('month', NOW() - INTERVAL '1 year') AND start_date < date_trunc('month', NOW() - INTERVAL '1 year') + INTERVAL '1 month'
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(trimp), 0)::numeric, 0) AS "TRIMP" FROM activities WHERE start_date >= date_trunc('month', NOW() - INTERVAL '1 month') AND start_date < date_trunc('month', NOW())

SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(trimp), 0)::numeric, 0) AS "TRIMP" FROM activities WHERE start_date >= date_trunc('month', NOW() - INTERVAL '2 month') AND start_date < date_trunc('month', NOW() - INTERVAL '1 month')

panels.title: GPS heatmap (stream data)
panels.description: Density of GPS points from stored Strava streams in the selected time range. A hidden marker layer (query B) supplies the map extent—Grafana’s heatmap layer does not participate in “fit to data”. Points are clipped by lat/lng percentiles to drop rare outliers. Strava may omit streams for some activities. After sync, activities without HR/power still fetch streams when available so routes can appear here.

targets.rawSql:
WITH raw AS (
  SELECT
    (t.point->>0)::double precision AS lat,
    (t.point->>1)::double precision AS lng
  FROM activity_streams s
  INNER JOIN activities a ON a.id = s.activity_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(s.data->'latlng') WITH ORDINALITY AS t(point, idx)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(a.start_date)
    AND s.data ? 'latlng'
    AND t.idx % 20 = 1
),
b AS (
  SELECT
    percentile_cont(0.02) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lat) AS lat_min,
    percentile_cont(0.98) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lat) AS lat_max,
    percentile_cont(0.02) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lng) AS lng_min,
    percentile_cont(0.98) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lng) AS lng_max
  FROM raw
)
SELECT r.lat, r.lng
FROM raw r
CROSS JOIN b
WHERE r.lat BETWEEN b.lat_min AND b.lat_max
  AND r.lng BETWEEN b.lng_min AND b.lng_max
LIMIT 50000

WITH raw AS (
  SELECT
    (t.point->>0)::double precision AS lat,
    (t.point->>1)::double precision AS lng
  FROM activity_streams s
  INNER JOIN activities a ON a.id = s.activity_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(s.data->'latlng') WITH ORDINALITY AS t(point, idx)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(a.start_date)
    AND s.data ? 'latlng'
    AND t.idx % 20 = 1
),
b AS (
  SELECT
    percentile_cont(0.02) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lat) AS lat_min,
    percentile_cont(0.98) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lat) AS lat_max,
    percentile_cont(0.02) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lng) AS lng_min,
    percentile_cont(0.98) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lng) AS lng_max
  FROM raw
)
SELECT lat, lng FROM (
  SELECT lat_min AS lat, lng_min AS lng FROM b
  UNION ALL SELECT lat_min AS lat, lng_max AS lng FROM b
  UNION ALL SELECT lat_max AS lat, lng_min AS lng FROM b
  UNION ALL SELECT lat_max AS lat, lng_max AS lng FROM b
) corners
